changelog:
Initial release of OpenClaw Team Collaboration Server.

- Secure zero-knowledge web interface for multi-user access to OpenClaw over local network/WiFi
- User registration with invitation code, password-based encryption, and strict data isolation
- All user data stored encrypted; server never stores passwords or hashes
- Device-based authentication with no session expiry
- Responsive interface for desktop and mobile
- Simple server setup and configuration instructions provided
